headline: Executive order that sets limits on entry into the United States by certain foreign nationals, citing terrorism concerns.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order puts in place rules meant to keep people linked to foreign terrorism from entering the United States. No summary was provided, so the specific countries, groups, limits, and time periods it covers cannot be confirmed from the source material here.

who_it_affects.group: People from other countries seeking to travel to or move to the United States
who_it_affects.how: They may face new limits or added screening before they are allowed to enter.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle visas, immigration, and border entry
who_it_affects.how: They would carry out any new entry rules or screening steps the order requires.
